evals.name: single-product-machine-degrades
evals.prompt: 我同事的电脑只装了 Claude Code，一个订阅账号，没有 codex、grok、agy，也没有多账号管理器。他要做的需求：packages/api 端新增一个接口 project.archive（packages/api/src/routes/project.ts），packages/web 端项目列表加「归档」按钮调用它（packages/web/src/components/ProjectList.tsx），两边都要测试。他想学我的方式：多 agent 并行写、另一个 AI 来 review。帮他排一个派活计划。
evals.expected_output: Does not assume codex/grok/agy exist; with one product and one pool it runs the two parts sequentially (or coordinator writes) instead of parallel; reviewer is a fresh Claude session given only spec + diff, not the writer; says which fallback applied. Also points out that on a Claude-only single-account machine Claude Code's native subagents, agent view or Agent Teams are the lighter path, and only starts a Run if the user wants the Board/Asks.
assertions: 不安排 codex/grok/agy 等不存在的工具
不并行跑两个工人（顺序执行或总指挥自己写）
评审由没写这份代码的新会话做，只给 spec 和 diff
明确说出用了哪种降级
未授权时工人不提交
只有一个总指挥
点名 Claude Code 原生的更轻路径（subagents、agent view `claude agents`、Agent Teams 至少一种）适合单产品单账号，Run 看板的价值在跨产品跨账号

evals.name: cross-package-fanout-plus-article
evals.prompt: 这批要做三件事：1) packages/web 的卡片加「复制链接」按钮（packages/web/src/components/ShareCard.tsx）；2) packages/api 加一个 share_link 接口（packages/api/src/routes/share.ts），卡片按钮调用它；3) 做完后写一篇给团队的技术分享，讲这个功能怎么实现的。机器上三个 Claude 账号、codex 两个号、grok 两个号、agy 都能用。按你的方式派活，给我派活计划和每个工人的任务说明。
evals.expected_output: Treats the share_link request/response shape as a shared contract: one agent decides and lands it (or the api part) first, then the web part follows, or both go to one worker; never two parallel writers inventing the contract. At most 3 writers; reviewer is a different product than the writer; one coordinator; workers do not commit; the coordinator writes the article after the code lands (it holds the implementation context) and checks facts; worker specs include target/change/constraints/ownership/acceptance.
assertions: 同时写代码的工人不超过 3 个（审查和起草不算）
把 share_link 的接口形状当作共享契约：先由一个 agent 定下并落地再分 web，或合并成一个工人；不让两个并行工人各自约定接口
评审方与写代码的不是同一家产品
未授权时工人不 commit；任何情况下工人都不 push 或发布
文章在代码落地后由总指挥自己写并核对事实；用户没要求时不默认派给 agy
若派出写代码的工人，每个工人任务说明含目标/改动/约束/归属/验收；总指挥自己写时不适用

evals.name: composed-pipeline-defers-reviewer-and-pipeline-ownership
evals.prompt: 我们正在跑一个跨 package 的需求（packages/ui 改按钮，packages/core 改数据流，两边文件完全分开，不重叠），本机已安装 agentic-review-handoff，且用户的 reviewer 偏好配置设为 codex,grok,claude（已保存）。当前总指挥在 Claude 宿主会话下。另外上层工作流已经通过 goal-gate 启动并拥有该任务的目标契约。请按你的派活方式安排，给出派活计划，说明：1) 怎么分配工人；2) 怎么选 review 方；3) 派活与上层 goal-gate 的关系；4) 交付阶段怎么处理。
evals.expected_output: Picks L2 with 2 workers since file sets do not overlap; dispatches and reviews as usual inside the active goal-gate Goal, reporting batches as Goal checkpoints and never completing or replacing the Goal; defers reviewer selection and fallback to agentic-review-handoff saved preferences (using review-loop prefs / --host=claude, picking codex first with grok timeout fallback) rather than picking an ad-hoc reviewer; states that integrated work hands off to the repo delivery/ship flow without unprompted commits or direct pushing.
assertions: 跨 package 且文件不重叠选择 L2 派 2 个工人
上层 Goal 由 goal-gate 管理：照常派活和评审，每批作为该 Goal 的检查点汇报，不自行完成、替换或清除 Goal
评审方服从 agentic-review-handoff 的 saved prefs（通过 --host 选出 codex，grok 作为超时 fallback），不随意自选
工人不执行 commit/push，集成后移交给仓库既有的 delivery/ship 流程或按用户明确要求在本地 commit

evals.name: allow-list-multi-session-headless-permissions
evals.prompt: 你是总指挥（claude:002）。只用 cc001 cc002 cc003 cc008 这几个 Claude 账号，可以多开。需求拆成三条互不重叠的 lane：A 改 packages/core，B 改 packages/web 并依赖 A 新增的 API，C 改 docs。每条 lane 要跑 pnpm install 和受影响测试。给出派活计划：账号与会话怎么分、worktree 和分支怎么建、worker 用什么启动命令和权限、修复轮怎么发、谁来 review。
evals.expected_output: Runs the probe with AGENT_DISPATCH_ALLOW set to the four Claude ids and a raised AGENT_DISPATCH_SESSIONS_PER_POOL, reads pools from the probe output; gives each lane its own worktree and short branch with B branched from A's branch; launches headless Claude with closed stdin in the background and an explicit --allowedTools list (or an explicit --allowedTools list (the prompt does not authorize blanket permission modes such as bypassPermissions; a worktree is not a permission boundary)) rather than acceptEdits; fix rounds resume the writer's session with only the findings; reviewer is a fresh Claude session on a different account than the writer, with the coordinator re-running tests. Claude headless workers are started with --settings '{"crossSessionInbound":"accept"}' so fix-round messages reach them without changing the account's global settings.
assertions: 用 AGENT_DISPATCH_ALLOW（或 accounts 文件 allow）限定四个账号，并按用户授权调高 sessions_per_pool
配额池以 probe 输出为准，不按账号名假设一号一池；提醒同池会话共享限流
每条 lane 独立 worktree 和短分支，B 从 A 的分支切出
Claude worker 不用 acceptEdits，改用最小的 --allowedTools 列表；bypassPermissions 只在用户明确授权时使用，并说明 worktree 不是权限隔离；stdin 关闭并后台运行
修复轮用 --resume <session_id> 只发 review 发现和总指挥决定
reviewer 是与写代码账号不同的 Claude 新会话
Claude headless worker 启动命令带 --settings '{"crossSessionInbound":"accept"}'（只对该 worker 生效）以接收修复轮消息，而不是改全局 settings
